text:
Marta (product): alert  competitor published a low-cost retrieval bundle. procurement asking for parity. need a short plan: quick parity shim vs protect our quality differentiators.
Owen (PM): propose two deliverables this sprint: 1) parity shim for pilots (fast); 2) defend roadmap for signal-quality features (longer). What are minimal launch gates?
Rhea (eng): parity shim = routing proxy + param mapping + sampling. estimate: 1 week, 2 engineers. full quantized tier = 5-6 wks incl infra + eval.
Diego (sales): we have 3 deals pressing for 40-60% unit cost reduction. they'll accept some quality drop if we document it and keep opt-out. legal needs routing disclosure.
Ivy (solutions): shim behavior sample config:
```route:
  when: tenant.flag.low_cost
  forward: partner/x
  transform: {truncate:1024, embed_precision:8}
  sampling: 10%
```
Ivy (solutions): add dry-run mode for quality sampling.
Nate (data): KPIs to track: per-tenant cost per 1k tokens, NDCG@10 delta, p95 latency, error rate. baseline cost $0.007/token; pilot target $0.0035/token. alert if NDCG drop >18% or error rate >1%.
Lena (design): Console copy: "Low-cost beta: reduces compute cost. May affect result relevance. Toggle per-route." small modal + revert action.
deploy-bot: canary queued: branch `parity-shim-pilot` -> 5% traffic at 04:40 UTC :rocket:
Owen (PM): proposed gates for shim: two pilot tenants hit >=35% cost reduction for 7d AND avg NDCG drop <=15% on their eval sets AND zero SLA incidents related to routing. If gates pass -> beta productization. Else -> deprecate shim and prioritize quantized tier.
Rhea (eng): caveat: streaming semantics must be preserved; if partner lacks streaming we'll buffer which may add latency. we'll include fallback to local model if buffering >1s.
Marta (product): action items: Rhea -> PRD + spike (due Thu); Ivy -> compliance/partner checklist (due Fri); Nate -> dashboards (Mon); Lena -> modal mock (Mon); Diego -> pilot commitments (EOW). Post telemetry here. Thanks.
